## Summary 
 
Following [#18492](https://github.com/apache/nuttx/pull/18492), say hello to ESP32-P4 on NuttX! 
 
This PR adds support for Espressif's RISC-V-based ESP32-P4 chip on NuttX, supporting its ESP32-P4-Function-EV-Board board. 
 
## Impact 
 
Impact on user: Yes. They now can start designing applications using NuttX on the brand new ESP32-P4 SoC. 
 
Impact on build: No. 
 
Impact on hardware: Yes. New hardware is being add! 
 
Impact on documentation: Yes. Documentation is provided for ESP32-P4 and ESP32-P4-Function-EV-Board. 
 
Impact on security: No. 
 
Impact on compatibility: No. 
 
## Testing 
 
All provided defconfigs are already being tested on our internal CI with HW in the loop. As an example, `ostest` can be tested manually. 
 
### Building 
 
Build and flash using UART0. Please note that, depending on the board version, it might be necessary to attach an external USB-to-UART bridge connected to UARTO pins and set the board to download mode. Please, check the `Flashing` section at `Documentation/platforms/risc-v/esp32p4/boards/esp32p4-function-ev-board/index.rst` (in this very same PR). 
 
```
make distclean
./tools/configure.sh -S esp32p4-function-ev-board:ostest
make flash ESPTOOL_PORT=/dev/ttyUSB0
```
 
### Running 
 
Run it with `picocom`, for instance. 
```
picocom -b 115200 /dev/ttyUSB0
```
 
And, on NuttShell, run `ostest`: 
 
```
nsh> ostest
```

调研完成，全部基于 GitHub API 实测（未改任何文件）。按问题编号给结论：

## 1. 上游 esp32p4 MIPI-DSI 主控：✅ 已支持（2026-08 刚合入）
- 驱动不在猜的路径 `arch/risc-v/src/esp32p4/`（该目录现仅剩 hal/Kconfig 胶水），而在 **`arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif/esp_mipi_dsi.c`（1716 行）+ esp_mipi_dsi.h**，配套 `esp_ldo.c/h`（MIPI PHY 供电 LDO）。实测目录列表确认存在。
  - https://api.github.com/repos/apache/nuttx/contents/arch/risc-v/src/common/espressif?ref=master
  - 合入证据：https://www.mail-archive.com/commits@nuttx.apache.org/msg168139.html
- 通用框架已就位：`drivers/video/mipidsi/`（host/device/packet）+ `include/nuttx/video/mipi_dsi.h`、`mipi_display.h`
- 官方文档外设表：MIPI DSI = Yes（LCD Interface = No、MIPI CSI = No）
  - https://nuttx.apache.org/docs/latest/platforms/risc-v/esp32p4/index.html

## 2. boards/risc-v/esp32p4：4 块板
`common`、**`esp32p4-function-ev-board`（存在）**、`esp32p4-pico-wifi-wareshare`、`esp32p4-tab5`
- https://api.github.com/repos/apache/nuttx/contents/boards/risc-v/esp32p4?ref=master
- **function-ev-board 无显示初始化**：src/ 仅 boot/bringup/buttons/ethernet/gpio/reset，configs/ 无 lcd/lvgl 配置（板子由 PR #18516 引入时就不含显示）
  - https://github.com/apache/nuttx/pull/18516
- 显示参考实现在 **esp32p4-tab5**：ST7121/ST7123 面板 DSI 驱动 + 触摸 + PSRAM framebuffer 绑定 DW-GDMA + `/dev/fb0` 注册，configs 含 `lvgl_demo/lvgl_term/nsh/python`

## 3. EK79007 面板驱动：❌ 未找到
- `drivers/lcd` 58 个文件无 ek79007/mipi-dsi 类面板；GitHub issue/PR 搜 "ek79007" 在 apache/nuttx = **0 条**
- 可抄的移植源（ESP-IDF 系）：官方 init 序列 + 时序参数（1024x600@60Hz，DPI 48MHz，HSYNC=10/HBP=120/HFP=120/VSYNC=1/VBP=20/VFP=10，2 lane @1000Mbps，reset GPIO27/backlight GPIO26）：
  - https://github.com/espressif/esp-iot-solution/tree/master/components/display/lcd/esp_lcd_ek79007
  - https://components.espressif.com/components/espressif/esp_lcd_ek79007
- 另一参考实现：esp-hal Rust 版 https://github.com/esp-rs/esp-hal/pull/5596

## 4. 社区相关 PR：有一整条刚合入的系列（2026-08）
- **#19739 espressif: support MIPI-DSI and M5Stack Tab5 screen + touch**（6 连发：主控驱动/IO 扩展/LCD/触摸 GT911/LVGL 示例/文档）https://github.com/apache/nuttx/pull/19739
- #19684 LDO 支持、#19522+#19646 mipidsi 清零修复、#19219 Tab5 板基线 —— 均已 closed（合入）
- function-ev-board 的显示 PR：未找到

## 5. openvela 组织：❌ 尚无 esp32p4 显示（甚至无 esp32p4）
- `open-vela/nuttx`（dev/trunk 分支均查过）：arch/risc-v/src 与 boards/risc-v 下**都没有 esp32p4**
- `open-vela/vendor_espressif`：boards/ 仅 `esp32s3`
- 结论：显示这块在 openvela 是全新工作，可从 apache master cherry-pick 上述 commit 系列（5434dc9da54 等）

## 6. LVGL 标准接法
库在 `apps/graphics/lvgl`，示例在 `apps/examples/lvgldemo|lvglterm|lvgltouch`（tab5 的 `lvgl_demo` defconfig 即现成模板）。

**总评**：主控层（DSI host + LDO + fb 框架 + LVGL 接法）上游全有且很新，可直接抄/提；缺的只有 EK79007 面板驱动和 function-ev-board 板级显示 bring-up——正好是你们可以贡献上游的空白点，面板 init 序列从 esp-iot-solution 移植即可。
